name: arm up rotator stretch
source_instructions: Raise one arm overhead and bend the elbow, palm resting on your upper back.
Use your other hand to hold the elbow.
Gently press the elbow back and down.
Keep your ribs down and chest open.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

Neutral ribs/chest, continuous crown-clearing reach, acquisition and reverse release.
